cohort: The study included 200 women undergoing repeat cesarean section at BLDE (D.U.) Shri B.M. Patil Medical College.
finding: The ultrasound sliding sign demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy (86.1% sensitivity, 85.8% specificity) for predicting intra-abdominal adhesions in repeat cesarean sections, with adhesions also significantly associated with maternal age (>30 years), parity (>=2), higher body mass index, and multiple previous CSs.
mod_finding: Intra-abdominal adhesions were significantly associated with multiple previous cesarean sections.
